UAT & Solution Validation.description: Coordinating User Acceptance Testing (UAT), authoring test scenarios, validating feature delivery against requirements, and sign-offs.

JIRA & Confluence Administration.description: Managing requirements, documentation repositories, traceability matrices, and ticket workflows in JIRA and Confluence.

Scrum Master / Agile Delivery Manager.title: Scrum Master / Agile Delivery Manager
Scrum Master / Agile Delivery Manager.description: Facilitates high-performing agile engineering teams, removes impediments, coaches teams in Scrum and Kanban, and optimizes delivery velocity.

Scrum Framework & Agile Ceremonies.description: Facilitating core Scrum ceremonies: Daily Standup, Sprint Planning, Sprint Review, and Retrospectives, adhering to Agile principles.

Sprint Planning & Backlog Refinement.description: Partnering with Product Owners to refine backlogs, estimate story points (Planning Poker), and define achievable sprint commitments.

Impediment Removal & Servant Leadership.description: Shielding development teams from distractions, proactively unblocking cross-team dependencies, and practicing servant leadership.

Agile Metrics (Velocity & Burndown).description: Tracking, analyzing, and improving sprint velocity, burndown/burnup charts, cycle time, and lead time to ensure predictable delivery.

JIRA & Agile Tooling Mastery.description: Configuring JIRA boards (Scrum and Kanban), managing workflow states, permissions, filters, and custom dashboards.

Team Coaching & Conflict Resolution.description: Coaching engineering teams toward self-organization, fostering psychological safety, and mediating team disagreements.

Continuous Improvement & Retrospectives.description: Driving actionable continuous improvement initiatives (Kaizen) from sprint retrospectives to enhance engineering velocity and morale.

Stakeholder Reporting & Alignment.description: Communicating team progress, release timelines, impediment escalation, and delivery health to engineering leadership.
